def parse(p):
    groups={}
    prefixes={'全社会':r'全社会用电量(?:累计)?','第一产业':'第一产业用电量','第二产业':'第二产业用电量','第三产业':'第三产业用电量','居民生活':'城乡居民生活用电量'}
    for group,prefix in prefixes.items():
        matches=list(re.finditer(prefix+r'([0-9.]+)亿千瓦时，同比增长([0-9.]+)%',p))
        assert len(matches)==1,(group,p)
        m=matches[0]
        groups[group]={'amount_100m_kwh':float(m.group(1)),'reported_yoy_pct':float(m.group(2)),'raw_fragment':m.group(0)}
    return groups
new={
    'stat_period_start':'2024-10','stat_period_end':'2024-10','period_kind':'SINGLE_MONTH','period_months':1,
    'original_period_label':'10月份','measures':parse(single[0]),'publication_date':'2024-11-21',
    'publication_time_intraday':'15:14','origin_date_stated_in_body':'2024-11-20',

    'raw_path':str(raw.relative_to(base)).replace('\\','/'),'raw_sha256':receipt['sha256'],

}

columns=['date','idx','decision_time','orders_available_at','funding_available_at','valid_features','exit_idx']+features

assert daily.idx.is_unique and days.is_monotonic_increasing
rows=[]
for k,s in enumerate(sorted(states,key=lambda z:(z['publication_date'],z['source_url']))):
    av=pd.Timestamp(s['decision_available_at_assumption'])
    i=int(days.searchsorted(av.tz_localize(None).normalize(),side='right'))
    source_complete=True
    measures=s['measures']
    quantities={g:measures.get(g,{}).get('amount_100m_kwh') for g in ['全社会','第一产业','第二产业','第三产业','居民生活']}
    nums=np.array([quantities[g] if quantities[g] is not None else np.nan for g in quantities],float)
    source_complete=bool(np.isfinite(nums).all() and nums[0]>0 and (nums[1:]>=0).all() and s['period_months'] in range(1,13))
    rp=base/s['raw_path']
    assert rp.exists() and hashlib.sha256(rp.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==s['raw_sha256']
    row={'event_id':f'E44_{k+1:03d}','root_event_identity':s.get('root_event_identity',s['source_url']),'source_url':s['source_url'],'raw_sha256':s['raw_sha256'],'raw_path':s['raw_path'],'publication_date':s['publication_date'],'origin_date_stated_in_body':s.get('origin_date_stated_in_body','SAME_AS_ORIGINAL_PAGE_DATE'),'known_at':av,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'stat_period_start':s['stat_period_start'],'stat_period_end':s['stat_period_end'],'period_kind':s['period_kind'],'original_period_label':s['original_period_label'],'source_complete':source_complete,'cause_identified':False}
    row.update({f'{g}原量_亿千瓦时':v for g,v in quantities.items()})
    row['四组显示量减总量']=float(nums[1:].sum()-nums[0]) if source_complete else None
    row.update({extra[0]:nums[2]/nums[0] if source_complete else None,extra[1]:nums[4]/nums[0] if source_complete else None,extra[2]:s['period_months']})
    if i>=len(daily):
        row.update(status='NO_PRICE_CALENDAR',event_support_complete=False)
    else:
        state=daily.iloc[i]
        row.update(state_idx=int(state.idx),state_date=state.date,decision_at=state.decision_time,exit_idx=int(state.exit_idx),entry_date=daily.date.iloc[i+1] if i+1<len(daily) else None,exit_date=daily.date.iloc[i+6] if i+6<len(daily) else None,orders_available_at=state.orders_available_at,funding_available_at=state.funding_available_at)
        assert av<state.decision_time
        clock_ok=bool(pd.notna(state.orders_available_at) and pd.notna(state.funding_available_at) and state.orders_available_at<=state.decision_time and state.funding_available_at<=state.decision_time)
        for field in features: row[field]=float(state[field])
        complete=bool(source_complete and state.valid_features and np.isfinite([row[field] for field in features+extra]).all() and clock_ok and i+6<len(daily))
        row['event_support_complete']=complete
        row['era']='2024—2025' if 2024<=state.date.year<=2025 else ('2021—2023' if 2021<=state.date.year<=2023 else '固定评估期外')
        row['status']='SOURCE_READY' if complete else 'NO_VIEW_INCOMPLETE_EVENT_SUPPORT'
        if row['era']=='固定评估期外': row['status']='AFTER_FIXED_PERIOD'
    rows.append(row)
events=pd.DataFrame(rows)
assert len(events)==52 and events.root_event_identity.is_unique
evals=events[events.era.isin(['2021—2023','2024—2025'])].copy()
assert len(evals)==51
support=[]
for _,cur in evals.iterrows():
    pool=evals[(evals.state_idx>=cur.state_idx-504)&(evals.state_idx<cur.state_idx)&(evals.exit_idx<=cur.state_idx)]
    complete=bool(cur.event_support_complete and pool.event_support_complete.all())

    support.append({'event_id':cur.event_id,'decision_at':cur.decision_at,'era':cur.era,'state_idx':int(cur.state_idx),'mature_events':len(pool),'training_event_ids':pool.event_id.tolist(),'training_state_indices':pool.state_idx.astype(int).tolist(),'training_max_exit_idx':int(pool.exit_idx.max()) if len(pool) else None,'same_pool_complete':complete,'status':status})
events.to_parquet(out/'全部52原根公告_同原构成与原八状态_无收益标签.parquet',index=False)
events.to_csv(out/'全部52原根公告_同原构成与原八状态_无收益标签.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
def clean(v):
    if isinstance(v,(pd.Timestamp,datetime.datetime)): return v.isoformat()
    if isinstance(v,np.generic): return v.item()
    if isinstance(v,dict): return {str(k):clean(x) for k,x in v.items()}
    if isinstance(v,list): return [clean(x) for x in v]
    return v
